mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 54 degrees and a moderate air quality alert in effect.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center has officially been awarded accreditation by the Wisconsin Association of Senior Centers for their commitment to providing excellent services and wellness activities for our older adults. Also, the Plan Commission is meeting on November 4 to review several development projects including a final plat for Ardent Glen.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Trivia night is taking place today at Hop Haus Brewing and Wisconsin Brewing Company, with another session at Paddy Mac's tomorrow. Also, keep an eye out for live music at Paddy Mac's and Lake Lou-ee, plus yoga sessions at Insight Wellness throughout the week.

Turning to public safety, the Verona Police Department released a report regarding an arrest made on Thursday, October 15, where a school bus driver was taken into custody for O W I. Officers confirmed that no injuries were reported during the incident.
The Culver of Verona is currently open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight. Although the specific flavor of the day remains unknown, it is a great time to stop by for a meal.
